correctness.rationale: At a=sA,b=sB,c=sC (A,B,C>0), the exact Exner–Pekař Bloch determinant has k^3 G+k^5 H+O(k^7) uniformly in phases, G=abc-2(a+b+c)-2[a cos(theta2-theta1)+b cos theta2+c cos theta1]. Its phase extrema give s_+²=4(xy+xz+yz) and the two stated reciprocal-triangle/nontriangle formulas for s_-². Strict sign changes yield Bloch modes for arbitrarily small positive k on s_-<s<s_+, while uniform definite sign excludes them outside. I independently reconstructed the critical fifth-order coefficient from the given trigonometric determinant: the upper-phase H is strictly positive under XY+XZ+YZ=1/4, as are both lower critical minimizing-phase expressions under bc=4 or 2(XY+XZ+YZ)-(X²+Y²+Z²)=1. Thus lower contact and upper gap at equality follow by phase continuity/uniform remainders. The width identity s_+²-4s_-²=2[(x-y)²+(y-z)²+(z-x)²] in the triangle regime and ratio²>=5 otherwise shows equality exactly at the equilateral shape. Numeric verifier is corroboration only.
